root_cause.text: The `tc_action` structure in the `net/sched` subsystem is immediately freed via `kfree()` when its reference count drops to zero, without deferring the deallocation through an RCU grace period, enabling concurrent readers to access freed memory during a race between filter creation and deletion.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `struct rcu_head tcfa_rcu` to `struct tc_action` in `include/net/act_api.h` and replaces the immediate `kfree(p)` call in the `free_tcf()` function in `net/sched/act_api.c` with `kfree_rcu(p, tcfa_rcu)` to ensure memory is reclaimed only after all pre-existing RCU read-side critical sections have completed.
